coach.mod.M16: Typing – more time to answer, larger keys
coach.mod.M18: Hearing – tone and volume check, headphones
coach.level.1.name: Beginner
coach.level.1.content: Koch set, characters one at a time
coach.level.1.goal: all 51 characters in the set, each ≥ 90 %
coach.level.2.name: Novice
coach.level.2.content: the whole set, shortening the gaps (Farnsworth), instant recognition
coach.level.2.goal: full speed 20/20 WPM, ≥ 90 %, median reaction ≤ 600 ms (PC) / 800 ms (phone)
coach.level.3.name: Intermediate
coach.level.3.goal: a stable lag ≥ 1 character, ≥ 90 % after alignment, normal gaps
coach.level.4.name: Advanced
coach.level.4.content: words, abbreviations, Q codes, call signs
coach.level.5.name: Expert
coach.level.6.name: Master
coach.next.u1Good: characters with ≥ 90 % in recent lessons: {good} of {of}
coach.next.twoSessions: meet it in 2 sessions in a row
coach.next.u2Speed: character and gap speed 20 WPM (shorten the gaps gradually)
coach.next.u2Acc: accuracy ≥ 90 %, median reaction ≤ 600 ms on a PC / 800 ms on a phone
coach.next.u3Step: step {step} of the copy-behind ladder: {name}, normal word gaps
coach.next.u3Tempo: pace at least {wpm}/{wpm} WPM, ≥ {acc} % after alignment, ≥ {n} characters in a session

coach.next.u3Drift.one: a stable lag – it does not run away by more than {n} character during a lesson
coach.next.u3Drift.other: a stable lag – it does not run away by more than {n} characters during a lesson

coach.next.u4Step: step {step} of the copy-behind ladder: {name}, {wpm} WPM
coach.next.u4Acc: ≥ {acc} % after alignment and whole words ≥ {words} %, ≥ {n} characters in a session

coach.next.u4Drift.one: a stable lag – it does not run away by more than {n} character during a lesson (a lag of a word is fine)
coach.next.u4Drift.other: a stable lag – it does not run away by more than {n} characters during a lesson (a lag of a word is fine)

coach.next.u5: U5: go through the copy-behind ladder steps {a}–{n}: QSOs, then noise, fading, interference and speed up to 35 WPM
coach.plateau.ttr: The reaction got faster from {a} to {b} ms.

coach.plateau.text.one: Plateau: {n} session without a new step. That is normal – the skill is consolidating and progress comes in jumps, not evenly.
coach.plateau.text.other: Plateau: {n} sessions without a new step. That is normal – the skill is consolidating and progress comes in jumps, not evenly.

coach.plateau.adviceChange: Try a change for a few days: shorter lessons 2× a day with a break in between, and focus on the characters that get confused (Progress → Koch path, confusions). A warm-up after sleep helps too.
coach.plateau.advice: Keep going with regular short lessons; the result of a session matters less than regularity.
coach.speed.ease: Two sessions below {acc} % ({pct}) – longer gaps give more time to recognise characters.
coach.speed.gaps: Two sessions ≥ {acc} % ({pct}) with a stable reaction – the gaps get shorter.
coach.speed.chars: Two sessions ≥ {acc} % ({pct}) without extended gaps – the character speeds up (gaps longer for a while).

coach.speed.plateau.one: Already {n} session without a new character – a change of plan: longer gaps give more time to recognise, then the new character comes more easily. The gaps shorten again after the full set.
coach.speed.plateau.other: Already {n} sessions without a new character – a change of plan: longer gaps give more time to recognise, then the new character comes more easily. The gaps shorten again after the full set.

coach.speed.nextGaps: Next shortening of the gaps after {n} sessions ≥ {acc} % at the same pace (so far {done} of {n}).
coach.speed.fullCopy: Full pace 20/20 WPM – the next step is copy behind (card on Home).
coach.speed.fullU3: Full pace 20/20 WPM – after 2 sessions with a fast reaction copy behind (U3) opens.
coach.speed.koch: During the Koch set the pace does not speed up (the new element is the character); the gaps shorten once the whole set is mastered.
coach.copy.nextU5Last: Last step of the ladder – a QSO on the band at 35 WPM, for maintenance. Head copy leads to level U6.
coach.copy.ease: Two sessions below {acc} % ({pct}) – a step back to allow time to consolidate.
coach.copy.nextU3Last: The last step of U3 – after {n} sessions ≥ {acc} % with a stable lag level U3 is done and U4 opens (abbreviations, Q codes, call signs, 21–25 WPM).
coach.copy.nextU4Last: The last step of U4 – after {n} sessions ≥ {acc} % and whole words ≥ {words} % at {wpm} WPM level U4 is done.
coach.copy.nextEarly: Trial copy behind from your mastered characters only ({n}), steps 1–{last} (groups). Character lessons stay the main thing for now – copy behind starts fully at level U3 and continues from the step you reach now.
coach.copy.next: Next step after {n} sessions ≥ {acc} % on this step (so far {done} of {n}).
coach.insight.weeks: In weeks with training on at least {days} days an average of {a} characters a week was added, in the other weeks {b}.
coach.insight.retention: After a break you hold {warm} % (end of the previous session {prev} %)
coach.insight.retentionDrop: – a slight drop after a break is normal and not a regression; the warm-up evens it out.
coach.insight.oftener: For faster progress it helps to train more often and shorter – ideally daily, even 2× 10–15 min.
coach.insight.regular: Your regularity is excellent – that is what makes most of the progress.
coach.next.u5Head: head copy (Copy screen): step {step} – QSOs at {wpm} WPM without interference, ≥ {acc} % correct answers (a session counts from {n} questions)
coach.next.u6: U6 Master – keep up head copy, also on the band (steps 7–8), and copy behind at 35 WPM; beyond that it is real operating and contests.
coach.head.name: QSO in your head, {wpm} WPM
coach.head.nextEarly: As a trial only step 1 (25 WPM without interference). The whole head-copy ladder opens at level U5.
coach.head.nextU6: The U6 step – after {n} sessions ≥ {acc} % level U5 is done and U6 Master begins.
coach.head.nextLocked: The next step opens with a higher level; consolidate this one for now.
